title: On Physical Components of Tensors in Elasticity and Inelasticity
summary: Widely used in mechanics and mathematical physics, physical components remove the inherent coordinate-dependent scaling in curvilinear coordinates, yielding components of consistent physical dimension. In orthogonal coordinates, they are constructed by normalizing the coordinate frame and coframe; in general coordinates, however, their construction requires additional, non-trivial choices. In this paper, we extract physical components of arbitrary tensors on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds by orthonormalization of the coordinate frame. We further formulate a general normalization framework…
